en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Imran Al Halby who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What is disliked from the birds?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When arrays its wings hovering upon your head’.
en.sarwar: 25. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Imran al-Halabiy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about what of the birds are undesirable.
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is whatever when flying over your head does not flap its wings.’”
